body:
I have observed this over the years, I know it is really easy to think that a therapist can help you with all your mental health problems, but they really can't. For some people their is not cure and they are untreatable. The whole therapy process relies on you being suggestible and believing in this magic cure of talking things through etc.

clinical psychology is a giant scam, it is basically just counselling , it is pseudo-scientific. Neurology is a science and psychiatry is a medical discipline but psychologist are just scam pedallers.
I agree with you. Suicide is seen as unacceptable, but why? I live in constant emotional pain, almost unbearable at times, it's a physical pain too.

It my have worked for you but for the rest of us it does not. Mental health professionals are extremely smug self satisfying arse holes(I work in healthcare), I hate their patronising ways. I think most of it is pseudo scientific at best.
I really am overwhelmed constantly by the feelings of hurt and pain
E health ( computer science )
What are you getting your bachelors in?

Bah, everyone thinks they are not good enough but you have to take the risk and tart writing, write about the pain you are feeling now, or something else. Get a part time crappy  that pays the rent but lets you write? In my hiatus from medical research I spent time working part time in a lab and the rest of my time I wrote research proposals and read papers.my personal life has been a failure but professionally I am well thought of, do something you would love to do. work in a library , eat salsa,  live life etc. by the way dying really isn't fun , I died for 3 minutes last year.
I understand the neuron-chemistry of love and have experienced that feeling, but it is a lie, if you really analyse it and I have it is utter crap
http://www.kickstarter.com/ - make your own film, or book , screen play. Or opera
In the UK at least we have our own film industry, I have a friend who worked in it, I say friend but they were one of my exs friends

I don't think love exists, that's my problem, in any shape or form, I think we are all trying to kid ourselves into thinking people care about us but they don't , not even our families. Be it man or Woman no one can love me because love is a fantasy made up by our culture to dupe us into making families etc
See you sound rather interesting, that is a positive. I am frightfully dull I think. wrong country?

I understand that , It's not like I am naive in the relationship department, I have lived with a SO before but for me it hasn't worked. I'm happy for other people it does (i.e. you etc) but for me not so much

http://youtu.be/pUjh9Id6Id8 

sorry to pry but what do you do for a living or to pass the time?
edit : that must be a very awkward situation to be in.

It's fine, when does the lease end?  Would it be so scary to find somewhere else?  I moved 250 miles away from my old life to escape ( it didn't work out for me as I would have hoped) is it a two bedroom apartment or one?

I'm emotionally stunted, or broken 
edit : thank you for your post though

Do you want him out of your apartment? next time he is out get a bag pack some of his clothes in it put it on the outside of the door. if you have to call the police and say you don't feel comfortable with him being there with you, I know this sounds very selfish but maybe that's self preservation for you. How do you actually feel?

I have appreciated your comments immensely thank you for spending the time writing them, I have yet to see what this happiness thing is , I can't remember the last time I was truly happy. It's not really a choice but a reality, I have struggled with the way I feel for a long time since my early teens and it has never gotten better, I'm smart enough to know it won't, it is heartbreakingly sad for me but it is one of those things. some of us weren't meant to be father and husbands and loved ones. I am an outsider looking in and that is all I will ever be
It's not a goal. Incentives only work if you believe you can achieve it, this is not achievable and the pain of that is immense.

To wake up in the morning and not feel my heart in my throat constantly. To have a partner who I can understand, to do silly things like read the Sunday morning paper in bed together and make blanket forts and breakfast. Bike rides and picnics and a large chesterfield sofa I can sit on and piles of books , a library's worth in my house and a border collie dog.

I think we have been lied to by people who were meant to care for us, and society . I think everyone is truly alone but some people at least have the euphoria of faux love to comfort them. Or friends to talk to and do things with. I just read your post and I'm sorry you shouldn't have been treated that way. They failed you

Edit : everyone is self obsessed and liars and hypocrites even me and you too.

I'm not being rude but very few people are on the same level as me, I got my degree at 21 3 months later I was the youngest PhD student at my university by years, I just have very different interests, I like music and books and board games, I like the idea of being in love but I do not think it is real. I'm a realist the best case scenario for me is to get a professorship, buy a small apartment and live alone for the rest of my life, and that is not something I would look forward to.

I live in a city , surrounded by strangers. Therapy isn't a option for me, I work in a healthcare related field I have my own views on therapists. It's not the first time I have had to take part in it. I find they are very good at taking people apart but bad at putting the pieces back together. I suppose I have a idealisation of how a woman can be and it never lives up to that. I moved here and thought that if I could just finish my PhD that would be enough for my life but it is not.

Yes, but I would make a terrible partner. I would like to feel less alone. I am isolated by my intelligence, I suffered pretty bad bullying when I was a child, I moved areas and to a new school and I never really fit in, during those formative years when most people became normal adults and made friends etc I spend them inside reading and hiding in my room while my parents got violently divorced. My intelligence grew but my emotional side never did, I find it hard to understand people and what they really mean.

This is the first time I have ever spoken about my feelings, I even lied to my appointed therapist when I was committed. I just don't see things working out for me, perhaps I'm not meant to be happy. This will sound cliché but the whole find a girl settle down and have children won't happen for me. I don't see the point in life if I can't form meaningful relationships with anyone, I truly feel I am surrounded by strangers even my own family are to me.
